topic: The 4% withdrawal rule and how much you need to retire (Emmett vs Liv)

scenes.narration: Guessing your retirement number wrong can drain a nest egg in just twelve years. I am Doctor Dollar. Today's patient checkup starts here.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar in an exam room beside a nest egg labeled FOUR PERCENT RULE, comic burst banner reads RETIREMENT CHECKUP, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Emmett and Liv both want forty thousand dollars yearly in retirement.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man emmett and woman liv each holding a goal card stamped FORTY THOUSAND YEARLY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The four percent rule means withdraw four percent each year safely.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, doctor dollar holding a chart of a pie labeled WITHDRAW FOUR PERCENT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: That means they each need one full million dollars saved.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a giant target stamped ONE MILLION NEEDED, doctor dollar pointing, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Emmett wrongly guesses he can safely pull eight percent yearly.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man emmett scooping a big slice from a pie labeled EIGHT PERCENT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Liv carefully sticks to the tested four percent withdrawal rate.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman liv taking a small steady slice from a pie labeled FOUR PERCENT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Emmett retires early with only half a million dollars saved.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man emmett beside a small nest egg labeled HALF A MILLION, a confident grin, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Liv waits until her nest egg hits a full million.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman liv beside a tall nest egg labeled ONE MILLION, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Emmett's oversized withdrawals quickly drain his entire savings within twelve years.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man emmett watching a shrinking money pile labeled EMPTY IN TWELVE YEARS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Liv's nest egg actually keeps growing even as she spends.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman liv beside a steady nest egg with a green up arrow labeled STILL GROWING, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Emmett returns to full time work while Liv stays comfortably retired.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man emmett clocking back in at a desk while woman liv relaxes in a garden chair, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Save twenty five times your yearly spending and withdraw four percent. See you next visit. Stay financially healthy!
